ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin (Agenda) safe-mode reboot encryption chain — bcdedit safeboot + Winlogon AutoAdminLogon + forced restart
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin's signature 'reboot into Safe Mode to evade EDR, then encrypt' tradecraft: a process modifies BCD to set safeboot, writes Winlogon AutoAdminLogon/DefaultPassword so the box auto-logs back in as a SYSTEM-class actor, then forces a reboot — all within minutes on the same host. This is the Agenda/Qilin encryptor's documented launch sequence (Trend Micro / Sophos / Group-IB reporting on Agenda Rust/Go builds, 2023-2024), not a generic ransomware shape.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND Processes.process="*safeboot*") OR (Processes.process_name="shutdown.exe" AND Processes.process="*/r*" AND Processes.process="*/t*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval bcdedit_safeboot=if(process_name=="bcdedit.exe",1,0), forced_reboot=if(process_name=="shutdown.exe",1,0) | stats sum(bcdedit_safeboot) as bcdedit_hits sum(forced_reboot) as reboot_hits min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(process) as cmdlines values(parent_process_name) as parents values(user) as users by dest | where bcdedit_hits>=1 | join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Registry where Registry.registry_path="*\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon*" AND Registry.registry_value_name IN ("AutoAdminLogon","DefaultPassword","DefaultUserName","DefaultDomainName") by Registry.dest Registry.registry_value_name Registry.registry_value_data | `drop_dm_object_name(Registry)` | stats values(registry_value_name) as autologon_values values(registry_value_data) as autologon_data sum(count) as autologon_writes by dest ] | where autologon_writes>=1 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let WindowMin = 30m;
let Safeboot = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "safeboot"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project SafebootTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
          SafebootCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let AutoLogon = DeviceRegistryEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where RegistryKey has @"Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon"
| where RegistryValueName in~ ("AutoAdminLogon","DefaultPassword","DefaultUserName","DefaultDomainName")
| project AutoLogonTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
          RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData,
          RegActor = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          RegActorCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let Reboot = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where FileName in~ ("shutdown.exe","wmic.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(/r\s|/reboot|reboot |os where Primary=.True. call Reboot)"
| project RebootTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, RebootCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
Safeboot
| join kind=inner AutoLogon on DeviceId
| where AutoLogonTime between (SafebootTime - WindowMin .. SafebootTime + WindowMin)
| join kind=leftouter Reboot on DeviceId
| where isnull(RebootTime) or RebootTime between (SafebootTime - WindowMin .. SafebootTime + WindowMin)
| project SafebootTime, DeviceName, AccountName, SafebootCmd, Parent, ParentCmd,
          AutoLogonTime, RegistryValueName, RegistryValueData, RegActor, RegActorCmd,
          RebootTime, RebootCmd
| order by SafebootTime desc

let Reboot = SecurityEvent

| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(/r\s|/reboot|os where .* Reboot)"
| project RebootTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, RebootCmd = CommandLine;
Safeboot
| join kind=inner AutoLogon on Computer
| where AutoLogonTime between (SafebootTime - WindowMin .. SafebootTime + WindowMin)
| join kind=leftouter Reboot on Computer
| where isnull(RebootTime) or RebootTime between (SafebootTime - WindowMin .. SafebootTime + WindowMin)
| project SafebootTime, Computer, SubjectUserName, SafebootCmd, ParentProcessName, AutoLogonTime, ObjectValueName, RebootTime, RebootCmd
| order by SafebootTime desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda Ransomware - Safe Mode Boot Configuration Set via bcdedit
id: 0c9b3f4a-3f7e-4d0b-9b8e-2a7c6c9b1e0a
status: experimental
description: Detects bcdedit.exe being used to configure Safe Mode boot — Qilin (aka Agenda) launches its encryptor after rebooting into Safe Mode so most EDR/AV agents do not start.
references:
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/22/h/new-golang-ransomware-agenda-customized-for-different-victims.html
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
author: detection-eng
date: 2026/06/08
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1562.009
  - attack.t1490
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\bcdedit.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'safeboot'
  filter_legit:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\msconfig.exe'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Admin troubleshooting boot issues via msconfig (filtered)
  - Disk imaging / sysprep workflows
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) ((@EventID:(1 OR 4688) @Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) @CommandLine:*safeboot*) OR (@EventID:13 @TargetObject:(*\\Winlogon\\AutoAdminLogon OR *\\Winlogon\\DefaultPassword OR *\\Winlogon\\DefaultUserName OR *\\Winlogon\\DefaultDomainName)) OR (@EventID:(1 OR 4688) @Image:(*\\shutdown.exe OR *\\SHUTDOWN.EXE OR *\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) @CommandLine:(*"/r"* OR *"/reboot"* OR *"call Reboot"*))) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
(#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 AND ((ImageFileName=/\\bcdedit\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/safeboot/i) OR (ImageFileName=/\\(shutdown|wmic)\.exe$/i AND CommandLine=/(\/r\s|\/reboot|call\s+Reboot)/i))) OR (#event_simpleName=AsepValueUpdate AND RegObjectName=/Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion\\Winlogon/i AND RegValueName=/(AutoAdminLogon|DefaultPassword|DefaultUserName|DefaultDomainName)/i)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function={ count(as=event_count) | collect([event_simpleName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, RegValueName, RegStringValue]) | min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen) | max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen) })
| event_count >= 2
ucs.rationale: The bcdedit/safeboot → Winlogon AutoAdminLogon → forced reboot triad on the same host within ~30 min is the published Agenda/Qilin encryptor sequence (Trend Micro Aug-2022 Agenda analysis; corroborated by Group-IB and Sophos coverage of Qilin 2023-2024). ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin Chrome credential harvester — non-browser process touching Chrome 'Login Data' / 'Local State' (Sophos-documented Qilin TTP)
ucs.description: Hunts the credential-theft module Sophos publicly attributed to a Qilin affiliate in Aug-2024: a PowerShell/Rust binary, pushed via Group Policy on a compromised DC, runs at user logon and reads Chrome's SQLite Login Data plus Local State (for the AES key) to exfiltrate every saved credential before the encryptor fires. Detection focuses on non-browser, non-backup processes accessing those exact Chrome User Data artifacts.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process IN ("*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\*Login Data*", "*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\*Local State*", "*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\*Cookies*", "*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\*Web Data*") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","rundll32.exe","mshta.exe","certutil.exe","esentutl.exe","robocopy.exe","xcopy.exe","7z.exe","7za.exe","sqlite3.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | append [ | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Endpoint.Filesystem.file_path="*\\Google\\Chrome\\User Data\\*" AND Endpoint.Filesystem.file_name IN ("Login Data","Local State","Cookies","Web Data") AND Endpoint.Filesystem.process_name NOT IN ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","brave.exe","firefox.exe","explorer.exe","onedrive.exe","backup.exe","chromedriver.exe") by Endpoint.Filesystem.dest Endpoint.Filesystem.user Endpoint.Filesystem.process_name Endpoint.Filesystem.file_path Endpoint.Filesystem.file_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` ] | search NOT user="*$" | stats sum(count) as hits min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(process) as cmdlines values(process_name) as actors values(file_path) as paths values(parent_process_name) as parents by dest user | where hits>=1 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let ChromeArtifacts = dynamic(["Login Data","Local State","Cookies","Web Data","History"]);
let BrowserOrSync = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","brave.exe","firefox.exe","opera.exe","explorer.exe","onedrive.exe","backup.exe","chromedriver.exe","googleupdate.exe"]);
let CmdLineHits = DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where ProcessCommandLine has @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (ChromeArtifacts)
| where FileName !in~ (BrowserOrSync)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          Actor = FileName,
          ActorCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          Source = "cmdline_ref";
let FileTouchHits = DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(Lookback)
| where FolderPath has @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\"
| where FileName in~ (ChromeArtifacts)
   or PreviousFileName in~ (ChromeArtifacts)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ (BrowserOrSync)
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName,
          AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
          Actor = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ActorCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          Parent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          ParentCmd = "",
          Source = strcat("file_", ActionType, ":", FolderPath, FileName);
union CmdLineHits, FileTouchHits
| summarize Hits = count(),
            FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
            LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            Cmds = make_set(ActorCmd, 8),
            Sources = make_set(Source, 8),
            Parents = make_set(Parent, 8)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, Actor
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Lookback = 7d;
let ChromeArtifacts = dynamic(["Login Data","Local State","Cookies","Web Data","History"]);
let BrowserOrSync = dynamic(["chrome.exe","msedge.exe","brave.exe","firefox.exe","opera.exe","explorer.exe","onedrive.exe","chromedriver.exe","googleupdate.exe"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
| where EventID == 4688
| where CommandLine has @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\"
| where CommandLine has_any (ChromeArtifacts)
| extend ActorImage = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ActorImage !in (BrowserOrSync)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ActorImage, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| union (
    ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Lookback)
    | where TargetFilePath has @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\"
    | where TargetFileName in~ (ChromeArtifacts)
    | extend ActorImage = tolower(tostring(split(ActingProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
    | where ActorImage !in (BrowserOrSync)
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | project TimeGenerated,
              Computer = DvcHostname,
              SubjectUserName = ActorUsername,
              ActorImage,
              CommandLine = ActingProcessCommandLine,
              ParentProcessName = TargetFilePath
)
| summarize Hits = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            Cmds = make_set(CommandLine, 8), Paths = make_set(ParentProcessName, 8)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, ActorImage
| order by LastSeen desc
